mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND q.PUBLIC_YN = '1'
AND q.TYPE = #{vo.searchType}
AND q.YEAR = #{vo.searchYear}
AND UPPER(q.GIGWAN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{vo.searchKeyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(q.SOSOK) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{vo.searchKeyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(q.SUBJECT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{vo.searchKeyword}) || '%'
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT q.NO, q.ID, q.NAME, q.YEAR, q.TYPE, q.SOSOK, q.GIGWAN, q.LAWER, q.GUMAEK, q.ILJA1, q.ILJA2, q.SUBJECT, TO_CHAR(q.WRITEDAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRITEDAY, q.READNUM, q.BUGET, q.PUBLIC_YN, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATTACH a WHERE a.SREF_TABLE = 'TB_LAWQUEST' AND a.IREF_NO = q.NO ) AS ATTACH_COUNT FROM TB_LAWQUEST q
ORDER BY q.NO DESC ) TB ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{vo.firstIndex}+1 AND #{vo.firstIndex}+#{vo.recordCountPerPage}

SELECT q.NO, q.ID, q.NAME, q.YEAR, q.TYPE, q.SOSOK, q.GIGWAN, q.LAWER, q.GUMAEK, q.ILJA1, q.ILJA2, q.SUBJECT, TO_CHAR(q.WRITEDAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRITEDAY, q.READNUM, q.BUGET, q.PUBLIC_YN FROM TB_LAWQUEST q
ORDER BY q.NO DESC

SELECT q.NO, q.ID, q.NAME, q.YEAR, q.TYPE, q.SOSOK, q.GIGWAN, q.LAWER, q.GUMAEK, q.ILJA1, q.ILJA2, q.SUBJECT, q.QUEST_CON, q.RESPO_CON, TO_CHAR(q.WRITEDAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS WRITEDAY, q.READNUM, q.BUGET, q.PUBLIC_YN, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATTACH a WHERE a.SREF_TABLE = 'TB_LAWQUEST' AND a.IREF_NO = q.NO ) AS ATTACH_COUNT FROM TB_LAWQUEST q WHERE q.NO = #{no}
SELECT DISTINCT YEAR FROM TB_LAWQUEST WHERE YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY YEAR DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LAWQUEST ( NO, ID, NAME, YEAR, TYPE, SOSOK, GIGWAN, LAWER, GUMAEK, ILJA1, ILJA2, SUBJECT, QUEST_CON, RESPO_CON, WRITEDAY, READNUM, BUGET, PUBLIC_YN ) VALUES ( #{no}, #{id}, #{name}, #{year}, #{type}, #{sosok,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gigwan,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lawer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gumaek}, #{ilja1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ilja2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subject}, #{questCon,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{respoCon,jdbcType=CLOB}, SYSDATE, 0, #{buget,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{publicYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LAWQUEST SET YEAR = #{year}, TYPE = #{type}, SOSOK = #{sosok,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, GIGWAN = #{gigwan,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAWER = #{lawer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, GUMAEK = #{gumaek}, ILJA1 = #{ilja1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ILJA2 = #{ilja2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SUBJECT = #{subject}, QUEST_CON = #{questCon,jdbcType=CLOB}, RESPO_CON = #{respoCon,jdbcType=CLOB}, BUGET = #{buget,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PUBLIC_YN = #{publicYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE NO = #{no}
UPDATE TB_LAWQUEST SET READNUM = NVL(READNUM,0) + 1 WHERE NO = #{no}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LAWQUEST_ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_SABUN = #{sabun}

SELECT a.ADMIN_SABUN, a.ADMIN_NAME, u.USER_NM, o.ORGNZT_NM FROM TB_LAWQUEST_ADMIN a LEFT JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER u ON u.USER_ID = a.ADMIN_SABUN LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID ORDER BY a.ADMIN_SABUN

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.USER_ID AS "userId", u.USER_NM AS "userNm", u.USER_SE AS "userSe", o.ORGNZT_NM AS "orgnztNm", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LAWQUEST_ADMIN a WHERE a.ADMIN_SABUN = u.USER_ID) AS "already" FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID WHERE UPPER(u.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{kw}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{kw}) || '%' ORDER BY u.USER_NM, u.USER_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 50
